title: NLP, LLM & Generative AI
focus: Text processing, language understanding, Transformer, LLM, semantic retrieval, dan grounded AI applications.
shortDescription: Jalur spesialisasi pemrosesan bahasa alami dari TF-IDF dan sequence modeling menuju Transformer, pencarian semantik, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, dan keamanan Agent.
learningOutcomes: Menerapkan pra-pemrosesan teks adaptif, tokenisasi, dan klasifikasi berbasis TF-IDF maupun neural sequence models.
Menghitung mekanisme Scaled Dot-Product Self-Attention dan arsitektur blok Transformer.
Membangun indeks pencarian semantik berbasis Dense Embeddings dan Cosine Similarity.
Mengimplementasikan pipeline RAG dengan sitasi sumber serta penolakan jawaban tak berbukti.
Menerapkan kontrol keamanan isolasi Prompt Injection dan validasi izin alat AI Agent.

capstone.title: Grounded Academic AI Assistant
capstone.summary: Membangun asisten tanya-jawab korpus akademik berbasis penelusuran tergrounding, sitasi sumber, deteksi abstention, dan pertahanan Prompt Injection di CPU.

references.title: Vaswani et al. (2017), Attention Is All You Need
Lewis et al. (2020), Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
OWASP Foundation (2024), OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications
